title: Lost Vape Centaurus B60 AIO Pod System Kit 1600mAh 5ml
description:
Lost Vape Centaurus B60 AIO Pod System Kit 1600mAh 5ml
The Lost Vape Centaurus B60 AIO Kit, offering a 5-60W range, Quest 2.0 Chipset, and the UB Ultra Coil compatible UB AIO Pod for vapor output. Constructed from durable stainless steel and zinc-alloy, the Centaurus B60 AIO Kit is the smaller version of the B80 AIO Boro Kit. Crafted with an integrated 1600mAh battery, the 5-60W output range is perfect for those who want to use the UB Ultra Coils. Donning the UB AIO Pod, the Centaurus B60 delivers plenty of vapor and flavor from your favorite eJuice or nicotine salts.
Brand: Lost Vape
Unit: 1Set
Dimensions: 85mm by 43mm by 25.5mm
Battery Capacity: 1600mAh
Wattage Range: 5-60W
Voltage Range: 3.0-4.2V
Resistance Range: 0.15-2.0ohm
Chassis Material: Zinc-Alloy + Stainless Steel
Charging: Type-C Port
Operation: Button-Activated
Pod Series: UB AIO Pod
Pod Capacity: 5ml
Construction: PCTG
Fill-System: Side Fill System
Coil Support: UB Ultra Coils
Coil Installation: Press Fit
Pod Connection: Press Fit
Package: Gift Box
Each set contain:
1pc Centaurus B60 AIO Device
1pc 5ml UB AIO Pod
1pc 0.3ohm Ultra M6 Coil
1pc 0.2ohm Ultra M7 Coil
2pcs Drip Tips
5pcs Silicone Rings
1pc Metal Spanner
1pc Type-C Cable
1pc User Manual
1pc Warranty Card
